title: Personalized Basketball Cracked Wall Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Transform your bedroom into a court of dreams with the custom sports bedding set by Jeminise. This personalized basketball comforter is the perfect gift for basketball enthusiasts, allowing you to customize it with your own name and jersey number for a truly unique sports-themed bedroom decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Fully customizable with your choice of name and jersey number to create a one-of-a-kind sports bedding piece.
  • High-Quality Material: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric that is incredibly soft, comfortable, durable, and lightweight.
  • Warm & Cozy Fill: Features a whole-piece microfiber filling with tight, smooth, and compact stitching to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Vibrant & Fade-Resistant: Crafted using environmental protection techniques that enable the fabric to hold dye beautifully, preventing fading over years of use.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water. Microfiber dries quickly on air dry without heat and becomes even fluffier than before.
  • Flexible Set Options: Choose between a duvet cover or comforter, and customize your setup with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheets.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Style Basketball
Theme Sports
Pattern Basketball Print
Customization Name and Number (2 text inputs)
Available Sizes Twin, Full, Queen, King
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
